excerpt_i18n.en:
Currently, Agent is emerging as one of the most explosive directions in AI applications: capital is heavily invested, players are rushing to enter the field, and companies are racing to implement Agent, fearing to fall behind. According to IDC projections, the conservative estimate for the market size of enterprise-level Agent applications in China is set to reach $27 billion by 2028.

Amid the buzz, challenges in Agent implementation are gradually surfacing. On one hand, the breadth, depth, and efficiency of Agent task execution are still constrained by technology; for instance, using multiple Agents to solve complex problems might require waiting half an hour or longer. On the other hand, issues such as model selection, identifying application scenarios, and Agent deployment are causing confusion for businesses.

With opportunities and challenges coexisting, vendors and players are constantly contemplating their roles in the Agent arena: some position themselves as full-stack AI service providers, leveraging their AI and cloud infrastructure strengths to compete comprehensively; others opt for strategic alliances to carve out a share of the Agent application market; while some focus on becoming specialized experts, aiming to secure a niche in the Agent field with deep vertical expertise.

In this competitive landscape, early adopters are attempting to offer their interim insights. In the crowded Agent race, how can leading players break through? Globally, AI giants and major cloud providers are the two key players in the Agent track.
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, los agentes se están convirtiendo en una de las direcciones más explosivas en aplicaciones de IA: el capital apuesta con fuerza, los participantes compiten por entrar y las empresas se apresuran a implementar agentes, temiendo quedarse atrás. Según las previsiones de IDC, se estima que el mercado de aplicaciones de agentes a nivel empresarial en China alcanzará de manera conservadora 270.000 millones de dólares en 2028. Bajo este bullicio, los desafíos en la implementación de agentes también están surgiendo. Por un lado, la amplitud, profundidad y eficiencia de las tareas ejecutadas por los agentes aún están limitadas por la tecnología; por ejemplo, resolver problemas complejos con múltiples agentes puede requerir esperar media hora o incluso más. Por otro lado, cuestiones como la selección de modelos, la identificación de escenarios de aplicación y la implementación de agentes se han convertido en desafíos para las empresas.

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Leifeng Network learned that LeXiang, a B2B AI knowledge base product under Tencent Cloud, saw a 100% increase in new orders this year, with the number of enterprises using its AI Q&A feature growing fourfold and AI interactions rising 22-fold. It is surprising that such a traditional, niche enterprise tool achieved such significant order breakthroughs. After all, the enterprise knowledge base market is quite mature, having taken shape over a decade ago, with slowing growth and limited willingness to pay as it is often viewed as an internal management tool. So why did LeXiang's orders surge this year? The boom in business for knowledge base vendors is widespread, with the key variable being large language models, which have sparked a new wave of enterprise AI knowledge base development. In the era of large models, knowledge bases are considered infrastructure. As Tang Daosheng, Senior Executive Vice President of Tencent Group, stated: large models are the "brain," and knowledge bases are the "textbooks"; without learning relevant knowledge, even a highly intelligent brain cannot solve problems effectively. Tencent Cloud Vice President Da Zhiqian noted that early this year, Tencent Cloud internally asserted that "large models + enterprise knowledge bases" would be the best path for AI implementation. Over the past several months, this judgment has been validated, with enterprise demand for knowledge base construction exploding post-large models, showing a 3-5 fold increase. The enthusiasm for these knowledge base projects is evident from participation in related activities.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Leifeng Wang supo que LeXiang, un producto de base de conocimientos de IA de Tencent Cloud dirigido al mercado empresarial (to B), experimentó un crecimiento del 100% en nuevos pedidos este año, con un aumento de 4 veces en el número de empresas que utilizan su función de preguntas y respuestas de IA y un incremento de 22 veces en la frecuencia de uso de esta función. Es sorprendente que una herramienta empresarial tan tradicional y especializada logre un avance tan significativo en pedidos. Cabe recordar que las bases de conocimientos empresariales son un sector bastante maduro, establecido hace más de una década, con un crecimiento de mercado desacelerado y, además, a menudo se consideran herramientas de gestión interna, por lo que la disposición de las empresas a pagar por ellas es limitada. ¿Por qué los pedidos de LeXiang se dispararon este año? El auge en el negocio de los proveedores de bases de conocimientos este año es generalizado.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 10月17日，2025奥哲AI战略升级暨企业级AI平台发布会在北京成功举办。本次大会以“奥哲AI，开启企业新「智」变”为主题，奥哲首次对外发布了“奥哲企业级AI平台”，系统性展示了公司在AI时代的全新战略定位，通过 “AI + Data + 低代码” 三大核心能力的深度融合，成为企业数智化转型核心引擎，助力企业迈入AI原生新阶段，真正成为AI原生企业。 与此同时，本次大会汇聚数百名来自制造、金融、建筑、石油石化等央国企及行业头部企业代表、数智化专家学者与权威咨询机构合伙人，共同围绕“AI重塑企业价值”“企业AI规划及落地实践”等关键议题展开深度探讨，分享行业前瞻洞察与企业AI实践经验。 01奥哲AI，构建企业未来 奥哲创始人&CEO徐平俊在开场演讲中回顾了公司成立十五年以来的发展历程 ：从2010年凭借BPM产品强势进军流程管理领域，到2016年推出氚云、2019年发布奥哲·云枢，奥哲通过低代码助力企业数字化转型。目前，奥哲已深入千行百业，参与了一系列行业标准的制定， 并获得了IDC、灼识等国内外权威机构“中国低代码第一品牌”的认可。 近年来，奥哲着眼于不断进化的企业数智化需求，持续深化对于AI的应用与探索，徐平俊指出，AI正在重塑企业软件的逻辑，所有传统应用都面临与AI能力的融合重构。在AGI成为现实的未来，企业将由业务原生进化为AI原生，业务将实现自动化感知、自动化决策、自动化执行。 此次发布会奥哲正式发布的企业级AI平台， 将天然适配的AI技术与低代码平台相结合，为企业提供从AI、数据到应用的一体化平台， 标志着奥哲从低代码企业全面升级成为企业级AI平台提供商。 奥哲认为， AI已经不再只是未来趋势，而是正在替代现在；未来企业都将进化为AI原生企业。 在徐平俊的战略演讲后，奥哲的企业级AI平台在到场嘉宾的集体见证下隆重发布。   02奥哲企
excerpt_i18n.en: On October 17, 2025, the Aozhe AI Strategy Upgrade and Enterprise AI Platform Launch was successfully held in Beijing. Under the theme "Aozhe AI: Igniting a New Era of Enterprise Intelligence," Aozhe unveiled its "Enterprise AI Platform" for the first time, systematically presenting the company's new strategic positioning in the AI era. By deeply integrating three core capabilities—AI, Data, and Low-Code—it aims to become the central engine for enterprise digital and intelligent transformation, helping businesses advance into the AI-native stage and truly become AI-native enterprises. The event gathered hundreds of representatives from central state-owned enterprises and leading companies in manufacturing, finance, construction, petroleum, and petrochemical industries, along with digital intelligence experts, scholars, and partners from authoritative consulting agencies. They engaged in in-depth discussions on key topics such as "AI Reshaping Enterprise Value" and "Enterprise AI Planning and Implementation Practices," sharing forward-looking industry insights and practical AI experiences. 01 Aozhe AI: Building the Future of Enterprises In his opening speech, Xu Pingjun, Founder and CEO of Aozhe, reviewed the company's 15-year development journey: from entering the process management field with BPM products in 2010, to launching Tritium Cloud in 2016 and Aozhe Cloud Hub in 2019, Aozhe has supported enterprise digital transformation through low-code solutions. Today, Aozhe has penetrated numerous industries, participated in the formulation of industry standards, and earned recognition as "China's Top Low-Code Brand" from authoritative institutions like IDC and CIC. In recent years, Aozhe has focused on evolving enterprise needs.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 17 de octubre se celebró con éxito en Pekín la conferencia de actualización estratégica de AI de Aozhe 2025 y el lanzamiento de su plataforma empresarial de IA. Bajo el lema "Aozhe AI, iniciando la nueva transformación inteligente empresarial", la empresa presentó por primera vez su "Plataforma Empresarial de IA Aozhe", mostrando sistemáticamente su nuevo posicionamiento estratégico en la era de la IA. Mediante la integración profunda de tres capacidades clave—"IA + Datos + Bajo Código"—se convierte en el motor central de la transformación digital e inteligente empresarial, ayudando a las empresas a avanzar hacia una nueva fase nativa de IA y convertirse en verdaderas empresas nativas de IA. El evento reunió a cientos de representantes de empresas estatales y líderes sectoriales de manufactura, finanzas, construcción, petróleo y petroquímica.
